info.name: Ecommerce API Collection
info.description: Complete Postman collection for the Ecommerce Express.js REST API, including Auth, Users, Categories, Listings, Listing Images, Search History, Payments, Transactions, Refunds, Reviews, Messages, and Admin endpoints.

item.name: Upload Listing Image (form-data to Neon Object Storage)

formdata.description: Select an image file (JPEG, PNG, WebP max 5MB) from your device

request.description: Upload an image directly from your device using multipart/form-data. The backend streams the file to Neon Object Storage and saves the record in PostgreSQL.

response.name: 201 Created - Uploaded to Neon Object Storage
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Listing image uploaded successfully to Neon Object Storage.",
  "data": {
    "image_id": "7",
    "listing_id": "1",
    "object_key": "listings/1/3274be59-e925-4c02-abfa-4fbb1cf9be32.jpg",
    "content_type": "image/jpeg",
    "file_size": 102400,
    "is_primary": true,
    "access_url": "https://<branch>.storage.c-2.<region>.aws.neon.tech/<bucket>/listings/1/3274be59-e925-4c02-abfa-4fbb1cf9be32.jpg?...",
    "image_url": "https://<branch>.storage.c-2.<region>.aws.neon.tech/<bucket>/listings/1/3274be59-e925-4c02-abfa-4fbb1cf9be32.jpg?...",
    "created_at": "2026-10-22T06:00:00.000Z"
  }
}

item.name: Presign Listing Image Upload (Neon Object Storage)

request.description: Request a short-lived presigned PUT URL and server-generated object key to directly upload image bytes to Neon Object Storage from Flutter or frontend.

item.name: Complete Listing Image Upload (Neon Object Storage)

request.description: Verifies the uploaded object in Neon Object Storage, validates actual magic bytes and content length, and persists durable metadata in PostgreSQL.

response.name: 201 Created - Upload Verified & Saved
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Listing image verified and saved successfully.",
  "data": {
